text.p: Tele-Communications Inc is being sued by certain shareholders who allege misrepresentation of earnings growth and ability to continue achieving profitable growth, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Tuesday.
The law firm Dyer Donnelly & Lilley said it had filed the suit in state court in Colorado on behalf of a group of shareholders.
The purported class action alleges that Tele-Comms's operations were performing worse than the company would have had shareholders believe, the lawyers said.
"The complaint alleges that during the Class period, TCI falsely presented itself to the investment community as a financially stable company," they said.
The suit involves investors who bought into the company between January 10, 1996, and October 24, 1996, they said.
A spokeswoman for Tele-Comms declined comment on the suit, saying only, "These are typical for large companies."
